# Toolbelt by Crewcraft

> AI estimate software for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and roofing contractors.
> Describe a job in plain English (or attach job-site photos) and Toolbelt drafts
> an itemized, branded estimate the homeowner can e-sign and pay a deposit on
> online. Invoices create themselves, payments reconcile automatically through
> the contractor's own Stripe account, and quiet quotes are followed up
> automatically. Free plan: 3 estimates, no credit card. Pro: $29/month flat,
> everything included, no per-user fees, no contracts.

Toolbelt is built and run by a single founder and is mobile-first — contractors
use it from the truck. Beyond estimates it includes: invoices, a follow-up
engine, a derived customer CRM, win-rate analytics, a price book,
Good/Better/Best pricing options, automated review requests, scheduling with an
evening jobs digest, seasonal tune-up reminders, an equipment & filter log, a
permit & inspection tracker, water-heater quote packs, an electrical load-calc
helper, material order sheets, insurance supplement letters, client-side photo
reports, and a storm/emergency lead page with instant auto-replies.
